issues.failure_explanation: With \delta_N=N^{-\gamma/(2\gamma+d)} and J_N\simeq N\delta_N^2, the quantity \delta_N^2\sqrt N J_N^{\gamma-\bar\kappa} has exponent [2\gamma(d-1)+d-2d\bar\kappa]/[2(2\gamma+d)], not -(\bar\kappa-d/2)/(2\gamma+d) unless d=1. The displayed limit requires, for example, \bar\kappa>\gamma(d-1)/d+1/2, while (ks) only gives \bar\kappa>d/2 and \bar\kappa<\kappa-d/2<k-d. Similarly, (quadbd) requires an additional lower bound on \kappa relative to \gamma. These extra conditions are not part of the theorem's hypotheses, so the Cameron-Martin shift and the quadratic term are not shown to vanish uniformly.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add a stronger lower bound on k (and hence on \kappa,\bar\kappa) ensuring \delta_N^2\sqrt N J_N^{\gamma-\bar\kappa}\to0 and \delta_N^2J_N^{2\gamma-2\kappa}\to0, then restate Theorem laplaceapp/mainbvm with that parameter regime. This retains the BvM conclusion for sufficiently negative Sobolev topologies and still allows the C-norm application by choosing k large.
issues.overall_effect: The Laplace transform approximation in Theorem laplaceapp is not proved under the stated parameter regime; consequently the finite-dimensional CLT, the Wasserstein convergence in Theorem mainbvm, and the application Theorems bvminv and ganzwien lose support.
issues.title: Laplaceapp Cameron-Martin shift vanishing uses an unjustified power-of-N identity
issues.why_classification: The repair is not a one-line typo: it changes the admissible k-regime of the main theorem and requires rechecking the parameter choices. issues.failure_explanation: The constructed V^{(\varepsilon)} is constant on [0,\varepsilon/2], equals V on [\varepsilon,T], and is linear in between. Its time derivative has jumps at t=\varepsilon/2 and t=\varepsilon for a general C^1 potential V (e.g. V(t)=t). Hence V^{(\varepsilon)} is generally not in C^1([0,T],C^b), contradicting the stated regularity used in Proposition cstpert and downstream estimates.
